import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 10))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))

# 1. Fraud distribution by transaction type
fraud_by_type = df.groupby('transaction_type')['is_fraud'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars1 = axes[0, 0].bar(fraud_by_type.index, fraud_by_type.values * 100, color=sns.color_palette("husl", len(fraud_by_type)))
axes[0, 0].set_title('Fraud Rate by Transaction Type', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Fraud Rate (%)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
for bar in bars1:
    height = bar.get_height()
    axes[0, 0].text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.2,
                   f'{height:.1f}%', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

# 2. Transaction amount distribution by fraud status
fraud_amounts = df[df['is_fraud'] == 1]['amount']
legit_amounts = df[df['is_fraud'] == 0]['amount']
bins = np.linspace(0, max(df['amount']), 30)
axes[0, 1].hist(legit_amounts, bins=bins, alpha=0.7, label='Legitimate', color='skyblue', edgecolor='black')
axes[0, 1].hist(fraud_amounts, bins=bins, alpha=0.7, label='Fraud', color='coral', edgecolor='black')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Transaction Amount Distribution by Fraud Status', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].legend()
axes[0, 1].set_yscale('log')

# 3. Fraud distribution by hour of day
fraud_by_hour = df.groupby('hour_of_day')['is_fraud'].mean()
axes[1, 0].plot(fraud_by_hour.index, fraud_by_hour.values * 100, marker='o', linewidth=2.5, markersize=8, color='darkred')
axes[1, 0].fill_between(fraud_by_hour.index, fraud_by_hour.values * 100, alpha=0.3, color='lightcoral')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Fraud Rate by Hour of Day', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Fraud Rate (%)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))
axes[1, 0].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 4. Fraud count vs transaction type heatmap
fraud_heatmap_data = pd.crosstab(df['transaction_type'], df['is_fraud'], normalize='index') * 100
sns.heatmap(fraud_heatmap_data, annot=True, fmt='.1f', cmap='YlOrRd', cbar_kws={'label': 'Percentage (%)'}, ax=axes[1, 1])
axes[1, 1].set_title('Fraud Percentage by Transaction Type', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Fraud Status', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_xticklabels(['Legitimate', 'Fraud'])

plt.suptitle('Credit Card Fraud Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
